templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share confidential information for an evaluation or business relationship while protecting it from unauthorized use or disclosure.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
templates.description: Cover Page for the Mutual NDA capturing the deal-specific terms (purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law, jurisdiction) and party signatures.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software (SaaS), covering service access, restrictions, fees, privacy and security, warranties, liability limits, indemnification, and term and termination.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Uptime and support commitments for a cloud service, including target uptime, target response times, service credits, and remedies when commitments are missed.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Terms governing a provider's processing of customer personal data, covering processor and subprocessor relationships, security, data subject requests, audits, deletion of personal data, and restricted international data transfers (GDPR and similar laws).

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Terms for an early-stage product collaboration in which a design partner gets access to a product in development and provides feedback to the provider.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services and deliverables under statements of work, covering fees, ownership of work product, warranties, and liability.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a business partnership between two companies, covering cooperation, payments, a mutual trademark license, privacy, escalation procedures, confidentiality, and liability.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA business associate terms governing how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information on behalf of a covered entity.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing on-premise or self-hosted software, covering license scope, restrictions and obligations, fees, warranties, indemnification, and liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a limited-time trial or pilot of a product, allowing a customer to evaluate it before committing to a full commercial agreement.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to a services agreement addressing AI-specific terms, including use of AI services, input and output ownership, and restrictions on training models with customer data.
